"""Migrated case_lifecycle workflow for Meridian CRM 4.2."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Callable, NamedTuple


Record = dict[str, Any]
Guard = Callable[[Record], bool]
Action = tuple[str, str, str | None]


class Transition(NamedTuple):
    source: str
    target: str
    event: str
    guard: Guard | None
    actions: tuple[Action, ...]


def _field(record: Record, name: str) -> Any:
    return record.get(name, "")


def _non_empty(record: Record, name: str) -> bool:
    return _field(record, name) != ""


def _not_equal(record: Record, name: str, value: str) -> bool:
    return _field(record, name) != value


def _evaluate_set_value(value: str, record: Record) -> Any:
    if value == "=NVL(SEV_CD,'3')":
        current = _field(record, "SEV_CD")
        return current if current != "" else "3"
    return value


_TRANSITIONS: tuple[Transition, ...] = (
    Transition(
        "N",
        "A",
        "assign",
        lambda record: _non_empty(record, "OWNER_UID"),
        (("audit", "CASE_ASSIGN", None),),
    ),
    Transition(
        "N",
        "A",
        "auto_escalate",
        None,
        (
            ("set", "ESC_FLG", "Y"),
            ("set", "SEV_CD", "=NVL(SEV_CD,'3')"),
            ("audit", "CASE_ESC", None),
            ("notify", "escalation", None),
        ),
    ),
    Transition(
        "A",
        "A",
        "auto_escalate",
        lambda record: _not_equal(record, "ESC_FLG", "Y"),
        (
            ("set", "ESC_FLG", "Y"),
            ("audit", "CASE_ESC", None),
            ("notify", "escalation", None),
        ),
    ),
    Transition(
        "A",
        "P",
        "await_customer",
        None,
        (("audit", "CASE_PEND", None),),
    ),
    Transition("P", "A", "customer_reply", None, ()),
    Transition(
        "A",
        "R",
        "resolve",
        lambda record: _not_equal(record, "RES_DT", "00000000"),
        (("audit", "CASE_RES", None),),
    ),
    Transition(
        "R",
        "X",
        "close",
        None,
        (("audit", "CASE_CLOSE", None),),
    ),
    Transition(
        "R",
        "A",
        "reopen",
        None,
        (
            ("set", "RES_DT", "00000000"),
            ("audit", "CASE_REOPEN", None),
        ),
    ),
)


def fire(state: str, event: str, record: dict) -> dict:
    """Dispatch an explicit workflow event without mutating the input record."""
    updated_record = dict(record)

    for transition in _TRANSITIONS:
        if transition.source != state or transition.event != event:
            continue
        if transition.guard is not None and not transition.guard(updated_record):
            continue

        audits: list[str] = []
        notifies: list[str] = []

        for action_type, name, value in transition.actions:
            if action_type == "set":
                assert value is not None
                updated_record[name] = _evaluate_set_value(value, updated_record)
            elif action_type == "audit":
                audits.append(name)
            elif action_type == "notify":
                notifies.append(name)

        return {
            "state": transition.target,
            "record": updated_record,
            "audits": audits,
            "notifies": notifies,
            "matched": True,
        }

    return {
        "state": state,
        "record": updated_record,
        "audits": ["WF_NOMATCH"],
        "notifies": [],
        "matched": False,
    }
